assumption: For review only, assume declared model runs and human collection were completed competently and could populate the reserved tables. Do not reject for absent measured values. Do not assume successful qualification, human-visible uniqueness, favorable agreement, model superiority, a positive interface deficit, ranking changes or statistical significance. Assess the implemented design and retain result-dependent conclusions conditionally. Actual workspace model/human evidence remains uncollected; no such collection occurred during this review.

scientific_contribution.assessment: A modest but useful controlled visual-to-symbolic interface benchmark. The contribution is the visually selected graph terminal, independently varied fault state, complete optimal-set semantics and now executable task-aligned diagnosis, not shape matching, a new optimizer, visual-pair metrics, CAD scale or assembly representation. This coherent diagnostic resource is scientifically sufficient for acceptance at its restricted scope, even without a favorable effect.

construct_validity.assessment: Both visual binding and fault information have certified consequences for complete answer sets, with a matched answer-preserving visual edit. A/O/M joins distinguish same-task isolated successes from nonoverlapping marginal competence. The paper correctly restricts J to observed, noncausal outcomes and does not claim hidden-topology inference or physical repair. Human-visible answerability is not established by geometry identity alone.

dataset_depth_diversity_dependence.assessment: The release contains 84 constructions from 17 sources and 15 dependence groups, with 57 held-out constructions in ten groups. Census, exclusions, pre-search grouping, disjoint source-instance selection and bounded-search failures are retained and independently checked. Graphs vary, but most observations cost two or three restorations and many have one optimum. The finite-source and gold-conditioned scope is explicit.

ground_truth_scoring_shortcuts.assessment: Independent union-find enumeration and semantic validation check binding, all optimal sets, costs, budgets and component outcomes while accepting equivalent ordering. Missing, invalid and adapter-failed slots retain planned denominators. Matched controls and source/ID checks pass. Legal silhouette plus exact search remains strong at 624/684 held-out micro and 78.29% equal-group; the fired shallow-solvability gate is explicitly retained.

experiment_design_uncertainty.assessment: BA-004's central gap is resolved by exact-task A/O/M contingency counts, J with eligible denominators, signed same-task contrasts, common construction qualification and shared whole-group bootstrap draws. Zero-eligible groups, undefined draws, absent versus failed conditions and incompatible locks are handled explicitly. Independent tests confirm nondegenerate unequal-group bootstrap semantics. These remain finite-resource sensitivity summaries, not broad-population confidence guarantees.

reproducibility_figures_geometry.assessment: Snapshot, source and native-byte checks pass. All 15120 retained algorithm responses were replayed in memory from permitted inputs, and the full analysis report was reproduced. Qualification is rederived from raw evidence and locked before external collection. Failed adapter diagnostics retain exact streams. Real geometry and source poses are traceable, without claiming physical buildability or authenticating human identity by hashes.

presentation_cvpr_readiness.assessment: The main PDF has six content pages and references on page seven; the supplement has seven pages. Actual primary figures separate input, source context and evaluator GT. The five new interface columns map to executable fields, with 212 genuinely null planning fields. Embedded factorial labels remain small at print size, and the LEGO-Puzzles citation should eventually acknowledge v4 planning. Neither is a renewed major issue.

residual_limitations: The contribution is one narrow visual-to-symbolic diagnostic, not a new graph optimizer, hard-perception benchmark, hidden-connectivity inference task or physical-repair certificate.

Silhouette plus exact search achieves 91.23% held-out micro repair and the same micro paired/All-six success. This shallow-solvability result limits difficulty and novelty claims; it was not concealed or used for reselection.

Only ten held-out dependence groups support finite-resource sensitivity. Gold-conditioned search, repeated part types, imperfect similarity signatures and small exhaustive graphs limit breadth and generalization.
Of 1008 dependent observations, 802 cost two or three restorations and 598 have one optimum. Maximum complexity and source assembly size must not substitute for typical task depth.

Actual human qualification is pending: 84 pending, zero rejected and zero qualified constructions. Geometry identity and nonblank/clipping checks do not establish human-visible uniqueness. Adverse qualification must reduce the reported population; an empty credible subset cannot support human-answerable interface claims.

J uses model-specific observed A=O=1 eligibility and must not by itself rank general competence across models. One attempt, prompt differences, stochasticity and format failures prevent interpreting it as a causal internal-mechanism measure.
The declared rule denies binding credit to malformed multimodal repair outputs. Invalid rates and unconditional paired contrasts must accompany any interpretation as a binding limitation.

Group bootstrap percentiles and leave-one-group-out values describe finite-reference sensitivity, not calibrated superpopulation coverage. Degenerate algorithmic [0,0] J intervals do not establish zero population error.

Future model comparisons need actual pinned adapters/revisions and common qualification populations. Hashes cannot authenticate human identity or closed-book execution; public CAD, gold and provenance retain contamination and lookup risks.
Factorial figure labels are small at print size. Larger insets would help without changing the native evidence.
LEGO-Puzzles v4 adds explicit planning up to eight steps. Updating the cited v3 discussion would improve currency but does not remove the specific binding/fault/all-optima distinction.
Recorded constructor, TypeScript and browser validation was inspected, not rerun. No real human/model collection or physical validation was performed.
acceptance_rationale: Accept at 7/10 under the instructed experiment-complete assumption. The controlled binding/fault construction, complete semantic certificates, separated information conditions and honest shallow baseline form a modest but useful CVPR diagnostic resource. Round03 now implements the same-task joint and paired analysis required by the paper's central question, including unfavorable and undefined outcomes, common construction qualification and retained failures. BA-004 and BA-006 meet their testable closure requirements; earlier closures survive focused regression checks. This recommendation is not based on iteration count, Main's audit, a score floor or assumed favorable experiments. It does not certify hard vision, physical repair, broad generalization, successful qualification or learned-model integration failure. The remaining limitations reduce breadth and confidence but leave no unresolved central major or critical issue on this snapshot.
